settings.heading: The Story of Bleusalt: Behind Our Quiet Luxury Fashion Brand

settings.text: Bleusalt is inspired by a lifestyle in and around the ocean.

Founder Lyndie Benson always loved Cashmere but found it too precious to withstand the elements at the beach. We combined the softest fibers on earth with beautiful classic timeless styles and created a collection of luxurious quality basics for your everyday wardrobe or capsule wardrobe, taking you day to night and everywhere in between.

Luxuriously Soft Clothing to Elevate Every Look

Bleusalt was founded in 2017 in Malibu California. Lyndie drew from her lifestyle to create elevated, elegant apparel that leaves you feeling your best. Each design is a celebration of the quality basics that fit seamlessly into your wardrobe. Our sustainable luxury fashion is also made in The USA from Tencel™ Fibers, the softest fibers on Earth.

Inclusive, Sustainable Fashion

Bleusalt is proudly size inclusive and runs from a 00-3x. We promote working towards Zero Waste and encourage capsule wardrobes and minimalist dressing by choosing quality over quantity, allowing you to complete your perfect wardrobe effortlessly.

Shop Bleusalt’s Luxury Clothing Line

At Bleusalt we work hard each and everyday to make sure we provide you with the highest quality when it comes to our products and service. We sincerely hope you love it as much as we love making it for you. Shop our luxury fashion collection online or visit our flagship store in Malibu.
